name: Dynamic list-picker: <6 item disambiguation
description: Tests that a product query returning fewer than 6 results uses a dynamically created Content resource with declared variables (fix for Twilio 21656). Sends 'bunetto' which matches exactly 2 products.

Select first product via button — must send qty template (product_name variable)
